ops.title: Classifier-blocked verification must never be retried by rewording, model switch, or lane splitting
ops.body: Supersedes the workaround in papercut 4f4aac6, which is retracted. When OpenAI's cybersecurity classifier blocks a codex verification run (turn.failed 'flagged for possible cybersecurity risk'), preserve the denial and its evidence, mark the coverage UNVERIFIED, and do not re-dispatch the same verification with neutral wording, a different model or tool (Claude included), or split lanes. A repair lane must never receive a classifier abort as a 'defect' to reproduce. Allowed alternatives: a source-only, read-only review of the diff, and ordinary valid-Git lifecycle regression tests that construct no forged or corrupt objects. If the blocked verification is indispensable, surface it as an explicit user approval gate at the final reviewable step (root/user instruction 2026-09-27T00:08Z, epic 7389668).
